extraInstructions: IMPORTANT: You MUST import and use BOTH audioManager AND speechManager. Import speechManager from '../../../lib/sim-engine/speech'. Use audioManager.play() for sound effects (valid: pickup, drop-correct, drop-wrong, tap, success, error, celebration, hint). Use speechManager.speak() for spoken teaching slide narration, challenge questions, correct/incorrect feedback, and hints. The game must teach: (1) Food components — seven nutrients: carbohydrates (energy: rice, chapati, wheat, potato, banana), proteins (body building: milk, eggs, dal, paneer, fish, rajma), fats (energy storage: ghee, butter, oil, cheese), vitamins (protection: fruits and vegetables), minerals (strong bones and blood: milk for calcium, green leafy veg for iron, iodized salt for iodine), water (all body processes), roughage (fibre for digestion: whole wheat, salads, fruits). (2) Balanced diet — eating a variety of foods in right proportions so all nutrients are present. An Indian thali with rice, dal, vegetable, chapati, curd, and fruit is balanced. Eating only rice is NOT balanced. Do not waste food. (3) Types of teeth — four types: incisors (chisel-shaped, cut and bite food at front), canines (pointed, tear and rip food), premolars (crush food), molars (flat and broad, grind and chew food at back). Children have 20 milk teeth, adults have 32 permanent teeth. (4) Structure of a tooth — crown (above gum), root (inside jaw), neck (where crown and root meet). Layers: enamel (hardest substance, outer covering of crown), dentine (beneath enamel, forms bulk of tooth), pulp (soft centre with nerves and blood vessels), cement (covers root, fixes tooth in jaw). (5) Dental care and cavities — cavity is a hole in tooth caused by bacteria feeding on sugar and producing acid that destroys enamel. Plaque is sticky film of bacteria on teeth. Prevent cavities: brush twice daily with fluoride toothpaste, floss, rinse after meals, eat less sugar, visit dentist every 6 months, eat calcium-rich foods (milk, curd, paneer, green veg). Misconceptions: 'butter and ghee are proteins because they come from milk' (butter and ghee are FATS, not proteins — paneer and milk are proteins), 'all teeth do the same job' (each type has a special shape and function — incisors cut, canines tear, molars grind), 'sweets cause cavities' without explaining how (the full chain is: sugar feeds bacteria, bacteria produce acid, acid destroys enamel, cavity forms), 'brushing once a day is enough' (brush TWICE — morning and before bed). Default width=720, height=560. Use named export (export function FoodTeethGame), NOT export default. Export interface FoodTeethGameProps with width?, height?, onComplete?: (score: number) => void. Use double quotes for ALL strings containing apostrophes. Use 'currentChallenge' as variable name, NOT 'challenge'. Auto-hint timer MUST be exactly 10000ms.
